name: Adafruit Feather RP2040 CAN Bus
description: RP2040 Feather with an MCP25625 (MCP2515 + transceiver) CAN 2.0B controller on SPI, 3.5 mm terminal block, switchable 120 ohm termination, 8 MB flash and LiPo charger.
notes: CAN is classic CAN 2.0B (no CAN-FD) up to 1 Mbit/s via an external SPI controller; chip-select GPIO19, interrupt GPIO22.
A 5 V charge pump (enabled by GPIO) powers the transceiver; CAN H/L/GND on a 3-pin 3.5 mm terminal block; 120 ohm termination jumper.
The terminal block makes the board about 12 mm tall.
The CAN control GPIOs (16-19, 22, 23) are used on-board and are not broken out to the Feather headers.
